text:
Devin (Sales): Quick sync — AtlasBank POC final readout scheduled Tue 11am PT. Need final metrics, security clearance status, pricing ask, and who presents. @Sam @Maria please confirm.

Sam L (Solutions): I'll present architecture + perf. Have latency/cost slides. Need final eval numbers from Jordan.

Jordan P (Eng): Perf numbers below — attaching quick results. p95/p99 stable except one tail at batch=8.
```
Success metrics:
- p50 45ms
- p95 180ms
- p99 220ms
- throughput 480 tok/s
- accuracy eval set: 92.3% pass
- prompt set size: 120 queries
```

Maria G (PM): Customer targets were 90% accuracy and <250ms p95 — we hit both. Need final commercial ask + docs link: https://redwood.app/atlasbank/poc-evals

Carol O (Security): Security questionnaire ~80% done. Waiting on KMS/HSM design diagram from Eng and SOC2 attestation date from Legal.

Jordan P (Eng): I'll drop the KMS diagram by Monday. Encryption at rest: AES-256, keys in customer KMS via cross-account IAM role. Example snippet:
```
kms:
  provider: aws
  keyAlias: alias/atlasbank-poc
  encryption: AES_256
```

Devin (Sales): Pricing note — customer asked committed capacity tiers. Proposed: 20% off for 3mo commit, 35% off annual reserved. @Sam ok to include in commercial slide?

Sam L (Solutions): Confirmed. Add demo of autoscale/burst to justify pricing. Also include fallback to a smaller quantized model for cost/lower latency.

Maria G (PM): Readout deck outline: Exec summary, success metrics, gaps & mitigations, ops/next steps, commercial ask. I'll assemble. @Devin you own commercial slide.

Devin (Sales): On it. I'll draft commercial + expansion play. Action items list please.

poc-deploy-bot: Staging deploy v2.1 succeeded for atlasbank-poc in us-west-2 at 2026-07-15T14:22:01Z

Jordan P (Eng): Gaps: hallucination rate ~7% on prompt set #3. Mitigation: stricter prompt templates, temperature=0.0 for retrieval answers, and a post-rerank filter.

Maria G (PM): For the readout, show before/after evals after fixes. Jordan, can you run a quick re-eval today?

Jordan P (Eng): Will run by EOD. ETA 5pm PT.

Sam L (Solutions): :thumbsup: 

Carol O (Security): Pinging Legal for SOC2 date. Will update thread when confirmed.

Devin (Sales): Final ask for presenters: Sam — architecture & pricing, Jordan — perf & mitigations, Maria — product outcomes. Anyone else?

Sam L (Solutions): that's fine. I'll prep a 10-min perf demo clip.

Maria G (PM): I'll circulate draft deck by Mon noon for review. Please add comments inline.

Devin (Sales): Thanks team. Goal: leave readout with expansion next-steps and LOI ask.
